decisions.reason: As a prominently presented extension of the firm's psychiatric treatment portfolio, it likely meets or is close to aspiration levels and can be supported with existing clinical resources.
The dedicated page and fit with the firm's workshop and production know-how argue for continued trial, although custom furniture is more market-exposed and somewhat less central than care services.
Outpatient sociotherapy is close to the firm's core mental health support activities, so even with modest website prominence management would likely keep it while evaluating uncertain early results.
Its homepage visibility and close link to the firm's eldercare offer suggest strong strategic importance and satisfactory early acceptance relative to aspiration levels.

The retail shop is only lightly signaled on the website and sits further from the reimbursed care core, so if results fall short management is likely to redeploy resources to the sheltered workshop itself or other core services.
